items.headline: EU ETS reform seen reshaping ETRM requirements
items.summary: Industry analysts discussed how proposed European Commission reforms to the EU Emissions Trading System could require ETRM vendors to adapt allowance tracking and compliance workflows.

items.headline: AI reporting tools gain traction in commodity trading
items.summary: CTRM analysts note AI-driven reporting has become one of the most adopted AI use cases among commodity trading firms, particularly for data management and risk reporting tasks.

items.headline: ACER opens REMIT reporting annex consultation
items.summary: ACER launched a public consultation (16 July–11 September) on a new Annex to REMIT transaction reporting guidelines for energy derivatives, clarifying overlap with EMIR reporting exemptions.

items.headline: Hapag-Lloyd suspends Odessa calls on security risk
items.summary: Hapag-Lloyd temporarily halted vessel calls to Ukraine's Odessa region amid ongoing Black Sea security concerns, while Red Sea disruptions continue to raise routing and insurance costs for traders.
